characters.description: An Earth cultivator preparing for the Twilight Ascent. He accepts Catheya's proposed pearl expedition and uses his remaining time in Twilight Harbor to equip himself, Port Atwood, and his hidden undead force.
characters.name: Zac

characters.description: A Clan Charvazi cultivator who organizes an expedition for life-death pearls. She offers Zac a reserved place, a route through the Twilight Ocean, and access to a method that reduces the realm's harmful pressure.
characters.name: Catheya

characters.description: Zac's revenant attendant and provisioning adviser. She chooses not to force an early breakthrough for the trial and prepares to carry his purchases back to Port Atwood.
characters.name: Velary

characters.description: A local guide who assists Zac with his initial purchases in Twilight Harbor.
characters.name: Nala

characters.description: The Draugr identity presented at Clan Charvazi's repository while arranging expedition skills and obligations. The clan treats him as an unusually wealthy elite associated with Catheya's party.
characters.name: Arcaz Black

characters.description: Catheya's master and a powerful Clan Charvazi elder. He kills the assassin attacking Zac, then binds Zac to deliver a sealed egg into the Twilight Chasm within three years.
characters.name: Catheya's master

characters.description: A Port Atwood defender and Valkyrie leader designated to receive the weapons, corpses, and cultivation supplies that Zac sends home through Velary.
characters.name: Joanna

characters.description: The name of Catheya's master, whose compulsory mission requires Zac to carry a sealed egg into the Twilight Chasm.
characters.name: Va Tapek

characters.description: A member of Catheya's expedition who rejoins the reduced squad while wounded after surviving an ambush and spending an escape resource.
characters.name: Varro

characters.description: A titan revenant combatant in Catheya's squad who collects and preserves freshly fallen bodies for later undead use.
characters.name: Catheya's titan revenant attendant

characters.description: The consciousness associated with Zac's spirit tool Love's Bond. The tool absorbs twilight fruits, and Zac treats their benefit to Alea as more important than improving his trial rank.
characters.name: Alea

characters.description: A member of Catheya's expedition who summons snakes to contain opponents during the fighting on Cork Island.
characters.name: Sharpo

characters.description: A powerful nature cultivator with a Dao branch who arrives to defend Cork Island's mother tree from Catheya's group.
characters.name: Tree-man elite

characters.description: The renowned tree-man warrior identified as the defender who fought Catheya's group at Cork Island's mother tree.
characters.name: Yanub Metal Leaf

characters.description: An array-capable undead operative who had posed as a member of Catheya's squad. He admits sabotaging the submersible and uses life-draining flower pollen to immobilize Zac and Catheya.
characters.name: Traitor in Catheya's expedition

characters.description: An off-screen designer overseeing a long-running tapestry of life-death conduits. Even damaged nodes continue advancing the design, which is associated with a pursuit of eternity and a limited timetable.
characters.name: Unresolved architect

characters.description: Zac's demon ally, confirmed alive inside the sentient dimensional seed more than two years after his disappearance. He quietly gathers resources and prepares to seek an opportunity beyond Billy's protected settlement.
characters.name: Ogras

characters.description: Zac's Titan-bloodline ally, confirmed alive within the dimensional seed. His close bond with the seed lets him rule a protected settlement in its increasingly stable internal world.
characters.name: Billy

characters.description: A Radiant Temple elf who runs a temporary settlement in the Green Grove Archipelago. He approaches Zac and invites him to a private meeting involving a Dao-treasure-powered spar.
characters.name: Radiant Temple elf settlement leader

characters.description: A beast king that attacks the temporary Green Grove settlement, seals the surrounding space, and traps Zac inside with its swarm.
characters.name: Raksha Shrimp King

characters.description: A red-eyed Eternal Clan ranker with overwhelming strength and a blood-based Dao. She confronts Zac after the hidden altar erupts, demands the source of its energy, and attacks when he cannot satisfy her.
characters.name: Eternal Clan vampire contender

characters.description: The spirit associated with Zac's axe, Varun's Bite. It seeks a life-attuned treasure bone that Zac recovers during his climb through the Twilight Chasm.
characters.name: Varun

characters.description: An immense unidentified sea-serpent-like creature whose passage through the Twilight Chasm briefly cancels its downward current.
characters.name: Colossal sea serpent

characters.description: A low-status Blue Spring Sect disciple seen during Zac's bloodline evolution. He cultivates in secret by extracting useful energy from alchemical refuse and tainted surroundings while concealing the ability behind an obsession with discarded material.
characters.name: Kars

characters.description: A favored Blue Spring Sect alchemy prodigy who supplies Kars with experimental impurity-cleansing pills. His work seeks less expensive cultivation resources.
characters.name: Leondio Evredoc

characters.description: Twilight Harbor's remote ruler, first implicated when Zac sees the ruler's insignia on the colossal guardian hunting through the Twilight Chasm.
characters.name: Twilight Lord

characters.description: A Port Atwood fighter and Zac's disciple who is helping prepare for an incursion while Zac remains absent. She receives a token and letter offering her a separate dangerous opportunity.
characters.name: Emily

characters.description: The leader of Zac's secret revenant force. He declares Zac the Einherjar's progenitor and says the force answers only to him, while distinguishing himself from the earlier person who shared his body.
characters.name: Einherjar werewolf captain

characters.description: A former Mystic Realm figure now present as a revenant among the newly disclosed Einherjar force.
characters.name: Leviala

characters.description: The hidden identity of the Twilight Lord, recognized when he manifests an avatar inside Zac's concealed mine. As acting Earl of Twilight Harbor, he can issue sanctioned quests and coerces Zac into removing energy jammers.
characters.name: Evening Tide Asura

characters.description: A spectral survivor of the warlocks encountered during Ogras's isolated trial. He recognizes Ogras's inner shadow as a creature able to cross planes. He says Ogras could subdue it with a soul brand, though the required art is stored in a guarded tower.
characters.name: Surviving warlock's ghost

characters.description: A wounded Havarok scout whom Zac ambushes and takes prisoner while seeking information and a route out of the core ocean.
characters.name: Captured Havarok scout

characters.description: A hostile figure encountered within a Creation-shard vision. He denies placing Zac on the shard path and sets a century-long wager requiring Zac to reach him with five shards.
characters.name: Aether Lord

characters.description: A prisoner whom a princeling exploits as a diviner before the City of Ancients opens. He predicts that Arcaz Black will upset the city's fate and gives the faction's seals less than a month before they break.
characters.name: Captive Templar

characters.description: A noble who imprisons a Templar for his ability to read fate. In response to the prisoner's forecast about Arcaz Black and the failing seals, he orders heart-sealing brands prepared for his elites and plans to enter the City of Ancients within a month.
characters.name: Templar's princeling captor
